_about: Re-evaluation schedule for the experiment registry (docs/experiments/). Read by scripts/experiments/scoreboard.js. 'by' = what produces the numbers: grader (scripts/experiments/grade.js on the daily export), records (hand count on the export), replay (a tick replay; command or location in 'how'), report (descriptive only). 'need' = the sample arm of the registered pass rule; 'time_arm' = the date the rule forces a verdict; 'report_by' = no forced verdict, the count is reported to the operator on that date. 'recheck_days' = how often the numbers must be refreshed at the latest.

trail-straddle-trigger.on_met: operator decision (the gain term is not in the records)

reading-guard.on_met: build_enforce proposal; drop clause at the threshold

grace-backstop-stop.how: export records closed >= 2026-10-17 with grace_stop_paused; fires = worst_pnl_pct <= -20

need.metric: records with grace_stop_paused (and >= 6 fires at B = 20)

trailing-threshold.how: replay per docs/experiments/trailing-threshold.md; re-run on the closes since the last run, and 14 days / 20 bot trailing closes after any change of trailingTriggerPct / trailingDropPct

need.metric: positions whose outcome differs from the baseline

managed-hold-trailing.how: replay per docs/experiments/managed-hold-trailing.md on holds closed since the last run

need.metric: positions on which the primary rule fires

hold-age-alert.how: event study per docs/experiments/hold-age-alert.md on holds closed since the last run

hold-downside.on_met: none (capture does not reach the perf record)
